summary: Iteration 72 backend-only verification of CP67 Points 11 (retailer OTP observability + new admin diagnose-otp endpoint) and 15 (admin incentive report max_time_ms bounding + 503 mapping). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration72_point11_15.py = 22 passed + 1 xfail (documented pre-existing privilege-escalation bug). Regression run of iter 61-71 suites: 168 passed, 1 failure which was a stale source-string guard in iteration62 (force_credit_preview projection was later hardened to a lean projection) — guard updated, iteration62 now 21/21. Point 14 untouched, not flagged.

critical.issue: _verify_admin (routes/staff.py:250) only rejects role=='retail_staff'. Verified live: a 30-day role='retailer_manager' JWT obtained from /api/staff/retailer/auth/verify-otp returns 200 on /api/admin/staff/retailer/diagnose-otp, /api/admin/staff/incentives/report and /api/admin/staff/retailer-managers (leaks the full manager whitelist + all incentive rows). Privilege escalation; the new diagnostic endpoint widens the blast radius. Fix: whitelist admin roles explicitly (e.g. role in ('admin','super_admin')) instead of blacklisting one role.

minor.issue: Projection dict uses {'is_active': True} instead of 1 — works (True==1) but inconsistent/sloppy; also 'email' is projected but never returned.
limit has no upper bound and no Pydantic Query(le=...) constraint; the admin UI already sends limit=2000 and CSV sends 10000, so max_time_ms is the only guard. Consider capping limit (e.g. le=5000).

action_items: HIGH: tighten _verify_admin in /app/backend/routes/staff.py to accept only admin roles — retailer_manager tokens currently reach every /api/admin/staff/* endpoint (verified live).
Optional: cap the incentives/report `limit` query param and fix the diagnose-otp projection ({'is_active': 1}, drop unused email).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff.py is 1969 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; retailer auth/dashboard, incentive reports and staff CRUD should be split into separate route modules.

The max_time_ms(15000) call is wrapped in a bare try/except pass for old-motor compatibility; with the installed motor it IS applied (verified by a cursor spy), but the silent except means a future motor change would remove the bound with no signal. Log a warning in the except.

503 vs 500 classification is substring-based on the exception text ('timed out'/'time limit'/'maxtimeexceeded'/'networktimeout'). Prefer catching pymongo.errors.ExecutionTimeout / NetworkTimeout / AutoReconnect explicitly, with the substring check only as a fallback.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 new tests pass, 1 xfail documenting the admin-gate bug); regression 189/189 after stale iter62 guard update

seed_data_creation: TEST_ITER72_ prefixed: 2 retailer_managers (9998812345 active, 9998812346 inactive), 1 retail_staff (TI72-0001), 1 bill (TI72BILL001), 2 staff_incentives (registration + bill_upload), plus a 1200-doc synthetic staff_incentives batch for the large-load test. All deleted in teardown — verified 0 TEST_ITER72_ docs remain in retailer_managers / retail_staff / bills / staff_incentives.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Point 11 verified: GET /api/admin/staff/retailer/diagnose-otp returns all 7 keys, 401 unauthenticated, is_whitelisted/is_active/manager_name correct for active, inactive and unknown phones, phone normalisation (+91 prefix) works, explanation contains 'user will receive OTP' only for whitelisted+active+bound, otp_send_bound=true, otp_channel='both'. POST /api/staff/retailer/auth/send-otp: non-whitelisted -> neutral {success:true,'OTP sent if number is registered'} with NO delivery key, and the WARN line 'Retailer OTP requested by non-whitelisted / inactive phone: <phone>' confirmed present in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (10 occurrences). Whitelisted -> {success:true,message:'OTP sent',delivery:{whatsapp,sms,success}}. Unbound-dispatcher branch verified in-process (logger.error '_send_sms_otp binding is None'). Point 15 verified: report limit=100 -> 200 in 0.15s; 1202-row synthetic dataset with limit=2000 -> 0.57s, all rows returned, no _id leak; cursor spy proves max_time_ms(15000) on the primary find and max_time_ms=5000 on both retail_staff and bills find_one; fault injection with 'operation exceeded time limit' and 'timed out' -> HTTPException 503 with retry/narrow-filters detail, unrelated exception -> 500; per-row staff lookup failure degrades to staff_name=None instead of 500; registration/bill_upload filters and bill enrichment (bill_amount/bill_store/bill_status/bill_no) correct; report.csv unaffected. IMPORTANT harness note: motor's db.<collection> returns a fresh Collection object per attribute access, so mock.patch.object(staff_mod._db.staff_incentives,'find') is a no-op — use the _DBProxy/_ColProxy helpers at the top of test_iteration72_point11_15.py and patch staff_mod._db instead. Remaining open item: the _verify_admin privilege-escalation bug (xfail test TestAdminGateScope) — flip it to a normal assertion once fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration62 regression failure was NOT caused by this iteration: test_force_credit_preview_projection_is_full_doc asserted the literal source string find_one({'id': bill_id}, {'_id': 0}) inside server.force_credit_preview, but that handler was later hardened to a lean projection {'_id':0,'amount':1,'store_name':1} to avoid Atlas MaxTimeMSExpired. The guard was inverted/obsolete; updated (test-only change) to assert the lean projection. Root cause of the admin-gate issue: _verify_admin uses a role blacklist (only 'retail_staff' rejected) so any valid JWT signed with JWT_SECRET, including the retailer_manager login token, satisfies the admin dependency.
